in_sanskrit.name: Sharvi-Kaariyana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvi (auspicious, derived from shruti - hearing, listening, or learning) + Kaariyana (one who performs actions, derived from karya - action, deed, or duty)

in_telugu.name: శర్వికారియాన
